Done. Auto «Always allow» on Muse approval cards is in, with money cards left to the owner and Deny never clicked.

Changed files:
- `bridge/permissions.mjs` (new) — `permissionDecision()` (money regex → `ask`, everything else → `always_allow`) and `answerPermissionCards(page, {onAsk, log})`: scans visible EN/RU approval cards by their buttons, tags each card root, clicks «Always allow»/«Всегда разрешать» (fallback «Allow»/«Разрешить»), calls `onAsk` once per money card without clicking.
- `bridge/session.mjs` — `send()` answers cards on every poll, extends the reply deadline while an `ask` card waits for the owner, emits one «Muse asks for approval: <title> — answer it in Muse» line through `onDelta`, logs auto-approvals to stderr. New `session.approve(chatId)` helper.
- `bin/musebridge.mjs` — `send --timeout <sec>` passed as `timeoutMs`, new `approve --chat <id>` command, help updated.
- `bench/deepswe/relay.mjs` — `send` passes `--timeout` from `MUSE_RELAY_REPLY_TIMEOUT_SEC` (default 5400); `sendArgs`/`replyTimeoutSec` exported for tests.
- `tests/permissions.test.mjs` + `tests/fixtures/permission-card.html` (new) — decision cases (Tailscale EN/RU → allow, purchase/оплата → ask) and real headless-Chrome card clicking incl. RU and Allow-fallback.
- `tests/cli.test.mjs`, `tests/bench-relay.test.mjs` — `--timeout` in help / relay args.
- `README.md` — CLI additions and the auto-approve note (EN + RU).

Verification: `node /tmp/muse-perm-check/check.mjs` → `permission check ok`; `node --test tests/permissions.test.mjs tests/bench-relay.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/acp.test.mjs` → 14 pass; full suite 57 pass.

APPROACH: Policy lives in `bridge/permissions.mjs`; the page scan clicks only allow-family buttons (Deny unreachable by construction). `send()` polls it each cycle and stretches the deadline while a money card waits; `musebridge approve` and `send --timeout` expose the same path to the CLI and the DeepSWE relay.

LESSON: `innerText` merges sibling buttons into one line ("Deny Allow Always allow"), so card titles must be extracted from text nodes outside `button` elements (TreeWalker), and closed `<details>` content only shows via text nodes, not `innerText`.
